name: K3 security droid
description: K3 security droids were a model of security droid manufactured by Rim Securities. They had a humanoid-shaped body and a flat, dome-shaped head with two sensors at the front—a small red one at the left side and a light-blue eight-dotted circle with an additional dot in the center on the right side. During the early Imperial Era, a group of reprogrammed K3 security droids operated at part of the all-droid Vanguard Axis criminal cartel, an offshoot of the Droid Gotra.
